provenance.selection: First deposited section per donor within PsO lesional and healthy skin. Exclude PsA, non-lesional tissue and additional sections from the same donor. Predefined skin, immune, stromal and housekeeping marker panel. Within-array coordinates use the Visium v1/v2 nominal physical pitch. Acquisition stage and composition unavailable.

design.message: High risk marks categorical aliasing or no observed stage overlap. The linear fixed-effect rank diagnostic is reported separately. Local bounding boxes are coordinate-frame proxies.

pseudorep.message: Difference in BH call rates across sampling units; true discovery status is unknown for public cohorts.

composition.message: Feature-averaged explained energy on matched supporting sections, equally weighted within patient and across patients. A connected 2-D footprint must span a wavelength, with wavelength at least pi times the occupied square-grid pitch. Regridding can alter native geometry. Missing covariates, saturated fits and partial coverage limit interpretation.

nugget.message: Fine-band residual energy minus the estimated white-noise contribution is signed. Matched two-step spatial differences model locally smooth signal plus uncorrelated homoscedastic volume noise. Rough signal, heterogeneous noise and unequal occupancy affect this sensitivity screen.

measurement_scope.interpretation: Energy, semivariance and attenuation refer to the supplied measurement scale. For log-normalized inputs they describe variability after transformation. The procedure does not fit a negative-binomial count model or identify a noise cause.

statement: 基于公开存档数据，在患者/生物学重复级去混杂框架下的可复现性、统计功效与混杂敏感性审计。
